additional_info.subject: ID0392230-DC/Si-D/FR[170001705] - Jaguar iPace cannot charge CRM:00315002112
additional_info.body:
Hi Florian,
According to our R&D's investigation from a few months back:
"Please update your vehicle to the latest FW available. This fault is relevant for outdated FW versions and it has been acknowledged by Jaguar; it is consistent for pre-2021 Jaguar iPace models. Siemens and Jaguar are currently working together to solve these issues permanently.
In the meantime, we would recommend to let Jaguar update your vehicle with the newest SW available."
Is this the case for you? I cannot see if the plate of the EV has any indication of the manufacturing date.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0392230-DC/Si-D/FR[170001705] - Jaguar iPace cannot charge CRM:00315002112
additional_info.body:
Hi Florian,
I apologise for my confusion, the sessions I saw where from 11:30 GMT and your timezone is +1h. Now I could see the actual error and it's related to the same issue that R&D found.
The error is related to the a low Resistance from the EV side that results in a isolation failure.
Please update the EV and try again. If it's fully update please give me some evidence since we are not aware of these. Let me know if this will take time and we can reopen the ticket later for further steps.
Best regards,
Francisco
